t: Azorella yareta PFAF Plant Database
s: Azorella yareta is an evergreen Perennial. It is in leaf all year. The species is hermaphrodite (has both male and female organs) and is pollinated by Insects. The plant is self-fertile. Suitable for: light (sandy) soils, prefers well-drained soil and can grow in nutritionally poor soil.

t: Yareta — In Defense of Plants
s: Sadly, the dense growth of the plant makes it highly sought after as a fuel source. Massive chunks of these plants are harvested with pick axes and burned as a source of heat. Due to their slow growth rate, overharvesting in recent years has caused a serious decline in Yareta populations.
